records.real_world_identity_notes: The observation is best matched to the base road-going 2000 Ultima GTR: a mid-engine, rear-wheel-drive two-seat coupe with a five-speed manual transmission. This is distinct from the separately named Ultima GTR Race, from the later GTR640 and GTR720 variants, from the open-top Can-Am derivative, and from the later Ultima Evolution.
records.confidence_basis: The exact-year Car and Driver road test identifies a 2000 Ultima GTR and specifies a five-speed manual transmission, while its exact-year cockpit photograph shows the conventional road-car interior and floor-mounted manual lever. Auto Express independently lists the 2000 Ultima GTR specification and separates the later GTR640, GTR720, Can-Am, and Evolution variants. The checked-out curated dataset contains no existing Ultima record, so this case proposes a new record id.

records.specification_basis: The exact 2000 cockpit photograph visibly shows a continuous circular three-spoke rim, not fixed GT/Formula grips or a flattened conventional rim. The exact 2000 photograph shows a simple wheel without a readout on the rim, and the written cockpit description refers to separate plain analog gauges.
